instruction: Analyze this Frontend Developer resume excerpt and generate structured feedback.
input:
Target Role: Frontend Developer
Resume Text: Frontend Developer with experience in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React. Built responsive single page apps and integrated REST APIs.
Job Requirements: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, REST APIs, Web Vitals.

output.resume_summary: Junior to mid-level frontend developer with foundational experience in React and JavaScript.

verified_strengths.strength: Direct experience building React single-page applications
verified_strengths.supporting_excerpt: Built responsive single page apps and integrated REST APIs.
verified_strengths.relevance: Directly matches core React component requirements.

skill_gaps.recommendation: Migrate an existing React project to TypeScript to demonstrate strong typing proficiency.
Adopt Tailwind CSS for utility-first responsive styling.

job_specific_recommendations: Incorporate TypeScript type interfaces across API request and response data.
Detail page load optimization techniques and Core Web Vitals achievements.

section_suggestions.recommendation: Quantify outcomes with percentages or user scale.

bullet_rewrites.original_bullet: Built responsive single page apps and integrated REST APIs.
bullet_rewrites.improved_bullet: Architected responsive React single page applications integrating RESTful endpoints, improving initial page load by [insert metric, e.g. 28%].

supporting_evidence: Confirmed skills: React, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, REST APIs.

rag_citations.key_principle: Begin bullet points with active verbs like Architected or Engineered.

prioritized_next_steps: 2. Add quantified metrics to experience bullets.
output.limitations_and_uncertainty: Evaluation based on text excerpt; does not assess live application code quality.
